recipe.criteria: Straight-leg V-up: raise torso and legs together from low extended position, arms arc from overhead toward feet, then lower with control.
limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Eight-second controlled transition is illustrative, not a prescribed training tempo.
